environmentVariables.name: GRAYLOG_MODE
environmentVariables.description: bridge forwards to Graylog 7.1+ /api/mcp. api exposes the read-only REST tools (search, streams, fields).

environmentVariables.name: GRAYLOG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Graylog base URL. A trailing /api is accepted and stripped.

environmentVariables.name: GRAYLOG_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Graylog API token. The server builds Basic auth as base64(token:token). GRAYLOG_TOKEN is accepted as an alias.

environmentVariables.name: GRAYLOG_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: In bridge mode, hide tools that are not read-only. API mode is always read-only.

environmentVariables.name: GRAYLOG_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for one Graylog request.

environmentVariables.name: GRAYLOG_MAX_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Truncate tool output longer than this many characters.
